ordered_heads_protocol: reuse timed artifact profile domain and final_chain_heads tag with the single validation run
rules: Read bounded single-link SQLite bytes, scan before opening, and require an independent expected database hash.
Use the existing pinned database schema and immutable connection-image checks; reject WAL, SHM and journal sidecars before and after reading.
Require exactly one completed validation run, no dataset or terminal error, and empty model_calls, tool_calls, tool_attempts and approval_decisions tables.
Require exactly run_started, start/accepted-terminal for fixed scenario one, start/accepted-terminal for fixed scenario two, run_status_changed, in that order.
Validate lifecycle rows, provider actor, actual hash chain, both v1.2 terminal references, and record/usage hashes from the same terminal rows.
Derive the record set and timing projection from actual rows; apply the shared first-live timing and ordered shape checks without accepting caller projections.
Recheck database bytes after verification. A valid local hash chain is not independent proof of real Provider or clock provenance.
This completed-pair profile cannot validate partial or quarantined outcomes and never upgrades old first-live evidence. Runtime/source/control/store/review/publication admission remains separate.
